notes.title: Lair Update
notes.notes:
Featuring the latest installment to Grudge TV! This update includes 5 new levels where you descend even further down through dungeons. You venture past the frozen abandoned halls to get closer to the core. The Lair will throw several new enemies at you varying from a blood leaching slime ball to an armored laser beam demon! At the end of your trek through the Lair you will meet Cryptos, the gate keeper of the core. Finish him to continue your journey.. Brought to you by McBasils Burgers! 

- Added 5 new levels - Backlogged, Gravitas, Stark Falls, Distro, Funeral Rights
- Added new boss - Cryptos
- Added 6 new unlockable boss armors for the original 6 bosses in the game
- Edited player UI 
- Edited the gear selection for the player outfits
- Edited the enemy and player health bar UI
- Fixed the sword collisions (issue with not hitting certain creatures and destructibles)
- Fixed buildable issue for horde mode where player can pick up and place down turret and refill health 
- Added buildable ability to repair turrets
- Edited the level selection UI

notes.title: Patch 4: Horde fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed turrets of different types shooting eachother
Fixed AI in Dungeon Crawler mode not attacking player
Edited turrets to deactivate during mini boss waves in Horde Mode
Fixed turret count not updating after a turret is destroyed
Edited horde boss 1 to be smaller to reduce being stuck in small walk areas

notes.title: Patch 3: Horde Mode Update
notes.notes:
- Added new game mode: Horde Mode - Survive through 10 waves fighting 2 minibosses with the ability to craft your own defense turrets!
- Added in 3 new free armors: Snow, Grape, and Blue from our YouTube series: Grape Vs. Snowman!

- Reworked the inventory UI
- Added in 6 new sword trails
- Fixed lighting issues in several levels
- Fixed the camera stutter while player was moving
- Added enemy spawners that detect the amount of enemies and spawn them in according to the amount of enemies present
- Levels no longer require you to kill all enemies on the map to clear the dungeon
- Vomit hit now does 15 damage and causes a slight knockback
- Orbs dropped after enemy deaths now despawn after 20 seconds
- Fixed the unwanted camera stutter that occurred when the player rotated and moved
- Taken down the Christmas decorations :p

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/f9BUdW8V36IX8LtR6H/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
- *Added Christmas decorations to all the levels and Christmas lights in the locker room*
- *Added 4 new holiday themed bullets - Players do not need to buy them in game*
- *Added a new holiday themed outfit - Players do not need to buy it in game*


- Bullets no longer shoot 2 shots when trigger is fired
- Bullet upgrades have been tweaked for the following:
    - Rockets are no longer time based - Player is given 10 rockets when it is acquired
    - Shotgun is no longer time based - Player is given 25 shells when it is acquired
    - Laser is no longer time based - Player is given 20 shots when it is acquired
- The machine gun upgrade timer is now set for 10 seconds
- All bullets are half the size
- All bullets are now illuminated 
- Player only swings their sword once when triggering the melee action
- When acquiring a new weapon you are displayed a message for your damage multiplier
- While going over lava player takes on damage over time but after .4 seconds of exposure to lava they are killed
- When killed in lava their body sinks and a particle effect spawns on their location
- Player is able to sleep in their bed once between matches for a 100 grudge bucks to gain a slight health regen on the following match
- Player now receives grudge bucks & XP for each level cleared on top of what was earned within each level
- Boss levels now display the health bar of the boss you’re fighting
- Added subtle screen shake effects to the player attacking and being attacked
